scope: Author descriptive statistics of the supplied fixed-rate geometry-only process. Selective independent source/observable review is separate; these production values are not independently replayed. No phase proof or Maxwell dynamics.
intervals: 95% pointwise percentile bootstrap; not simultaneous or a finite-size-bias estimate
undefined_bootstrap_policy: If any resample has zero denominator, the affected entire interval is undefined; no resample is dropped.
standard_errors: Across-history sample SE for linear means; paired delta-method influence SE for ratios; undefined for fewer than two histories or zero denominator.
